source.title: UIS Cares - Stars Food Pantry Order Form

questions.label: Please specify your level of need:
options: Low:  I have enough food, and money to purchase more to meet my needs
Medium: I have enough food, but not enough money/resources to purchase more to meet my needs
High: I do not have enough food or money to purchase more to meet my needs. I am in great need.
questions.note: Self-reported level of need; not in the profile. The page also has an "Other:" free-text option, left out here.

questions.label: Please select food items you would like
Are there items you would like to have available to order in the future? Please list these items
UIS email (we will not fill orders placed with a gmail or any other personal email address)
questions.note: Must be the university-issued UIS email; the saved email may be a personal address, which the form rejects.

questions.label: I will pick up my order on:
UIN:
questions.note: University ID number (UIN); not in the profile.

questions.label: Phone number:
questions.note: The form validates this box as a number.

questions.label: Current Residence:
questions.note: On or off campus housing; the profile only knows the home address.
